## Passages
RESULT [curation]: DFN-5B lets a ViT-H reach 84.4% zero-shot ImageNet accuracy (arXiv abstract), beating models trained on LAION-2B, DataComp-1B and OpenAI WIT. DFN-2B was released publicly.
US [curation]: Supports building the weed filter from a small, trusted, human-verified weed set (as in the Phase A labeller: BioCLIP-2 with 61 exemplars) rather than assuming the largest or strongest general embedder is the best curator. The choice of curator (DINOv2, DINOv3 or BioCLIP-2) should be judged by the detector trained on what it keeps, not by the embedder's own benchmark.
CORRECTION [curation]: ICLR 2024 confirmed (proceedings.iclr.cc, dblp). A ViT-H trained on DFN-5B reaches 84.4% zero-shot ImageNet, beating LAION-2B, DataComp-1B and WIT. DFN-2B was released.
